name: YouCanBook.me
description: YouCanBook.me is an online scheduling tool that gives small businesses and service professionals branded booking pages with automated reminders and payment collection.
best_for: Small business owners, consultants, coaches, and service providers who want to automate appointment booking and cut administrative overhead.
features: Branded booking pages with custom logos, colors, and backgrounds
Support for multiple appointment types and in-person or virtual meetings
Calendar sync with Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, and Microsoft 365
Automated confirmation, reminder, and follow-up messages via email and SMS
Payment collection through Stripe, Apple Pay, and Google Pay
Multiple booking pages and role-based access for team scheduling
Integrations with over 7,000 apps via Zapier
